title: Calls, tasks and events share one notification rule each instead of separate rules
label: MISSING vs ZOHO
date: TAVI 9 Nov 2026 (live) · Zoho: help article (live Zoho Desk did not load on this network)
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner) · Setup › Notifications › QA AO Dept A › Agent Notifications

panels.caption: TAVI: one rule each for assigning, completing and mentioning an activity (1), covering tasks, calls and events together.
Zoho Desk help: separate agent rules for calls, tasks and events, starting with "Assigning a call" (1).

rows: Different notifications for calls, tasks and events
Nine rules: assigning, completing and mentioning, each for call, task and event.
Three rules shared by all activity types, so a department cannot, for example, notify on tasks but not on calls.
